result.summary: Found 3 issues: a missing image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section, a horizontally cut-off restaurant card in 'Fastest near you', and inconsistent image loading across the food listings.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing shows a broken/missing image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant photo
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads correctly or provide a proper fallback image for restaurants without photos

issues.description: The third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its text truncated
issues.suggestion: Adjust card sizing or add clearer visual indication (e.g., partial peek with fade) to show more content is scrollable

issues.description: Inconsistent image treatment between sections - some restaurant cards show illustrated icons (Green Bowl Poke, Smash Bros Burgers) while others attempt to show a broken real photo (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) or a pizza illustration below
issues.suggestion: Standardize image style across all restaurant cards for visual consistency, either all illustrations or all photos
